description: Plain white crew neck t-shirt made of soft cotton jersey fabric with a smooth, unadorned surface and a classic standard fit.
Black single-breasted blazer featuring notch lapels, a single front button closure, long sleeves, structured shoulders, and a classic tailored fit in matte-finish woven fabric.
Medium-wash blue denim jeans with a straight-leg cut, mid-rise waist, and standard classic jean construction.
Flowing floral print maxi dress in a boho chic style with bold floral patterns, long flowing silhouette, ideal for garden parties or festivals.
Black leather loafers with a rounded toe, low stacked heel, and a smooth polished finish suitable for both casual and formal wear.
Camel-colored wool overcoat with a double-breasted front, notched lapels, and a knee-length structured silhouette.
Tailored high-waisted trouser pants in charcoal grey with a straight leg and a crisp pressed crease.
Elegant silk slip dress in emerald green with a bias cut, thin adjustable straps, and a midi length hem.
Crisp white cotton button-down shirt with a spread collar, long sleeves, and a relaxed tailored fit.
Oversized chunky knit cardigan in oatmeal beige with a shawl collar and front button closure.
Black leather ankle boots with a block heel, side zip closure, and a rounded almond toe.
Classic blue denim jacket with a button front, chest flap pockets, and a slightly cropped fit.
Sage green pleated midi skirt in lightweight chiffon with an elastic waistband and flowing A-line silhouette.
Sleek black jumpsuit with wide-leg trousers, a fitted bodice, and a deep V neckline, suitable for formal evening events.
Minimalist white canvas low-top sneakers with a rubber sole and classic lace-up front.
Navy and white striped cotton knit sweater with a crew neck and relaxed long sleeves.
Black faux leather moto jacket with an asymmetric front zip, notched lapel, and fitted silhouette.
Flowy wide-leg linen pants in cream with a high waist and relaxed breathable fit, ideal for warm weather.
Fitted emerald green cocktail dress with a sweetheart neckline, knee-length hem, and subtle stretch fabric.
Classic beige trench coat with a belted waist, double-breasted button front, and knee-length silhouette.
